text.tspan: Powered from the RP4 3.3 V pin so DO
can never exceed the GPIO's 3.3 V.
Faces the propeller: one DO pulse
Flyback protection: the internal clamp diodes on
section 9.3.1, rated to 1 A). No external diodes.
PARMCO Checkpoint 2 motor and IR sensor schematic (AI-generated)
All ground symbols are one net: RP4 GND (J1 pins 14 and 20), supply GND, U1 pins 4, 5, 12, 13.
All +5 V and +12 V symbols come from PS1. Only the IR module (U3) is powered from the RP4.
J1 numbers are header pin numbers. U2 pins 3 (NC) and 6 (base) are left unconnected.
